## Summary

Briefly describe what this PR changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new capability
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `test`: tests only
- [ ] `refactor`: behaviour-preserving code change
- [ ] `chore` / `ci`: build, tooling, or workflow change

## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] Public types and methods have XML doc comments
      (`<summary>`, `<param>`, `<returns>`).
- [ ] New code follows SOLID / DI and keeps functions under 30 lines.
- [ ] `dotnet test` passes locally.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` if user-visible.
- [ ] No AI co-author footers in commit messages.
